description: Estimate one person's UK Self Assessment for one tax year (2025-26 or 2026-27): income tax on salary, dividends, self-employment and interest, Class 4, student loans, payments on account, and Class 1 National Insurance on a salary from the person's own company. Uses the same engine as A.X.E.L Filing's returns, which matches HMRC's own test cases. An estimate only: nothing is saved or filed. Never ask for a UTR or National Insurance number.

becameDirectorDuringYear.description: Became a director part-way through the tax year. Refused: a shorter NI earnings period needs HMRC's directors' calculator.

dividends.description: Total dividends received in the tax year, from any company

eligibility.description: Answer true for any that apply; each is refused as out of scope (refer to an accountant).

income.description: Income in ONE personal tax year (6 April to 5 April), all in POUNDS. Ask; do not guess.

interest.description: Bank and building society interest received

otherEmploymentPay.description: Pay from any other job in the tax year

salary.description: Salary from this company in the tax year (gross)

salaryTaxDeducted.description: Income tax already taken off that salary through PAYE

selfEmployment.description: A sole-trader business alongside the company, accounts for the tax year

overStatePensionAge.description: Over State Pension age: no employee National Insurance on salary (the company still pays employer NI)

payroll.description: For the Employment Allowance (up to £10,500 of employer NI). HMRC: a company with only one director cannot claim if that director is the only employee liable for employer NI. Ask both.

directors.description: How many directors the company has

othersLiableForEmployerNi.description: Is anyone else on the payroll paid more than £5,000 a year?

region.description: Where the person lives for income tax: rUK (England or Northern Ireland), scotland or wales. Scottish rates differ. Ask.

studentLoanPlans.description: Undergraduate student loan plans being repaid

name: estimate_uk_self_assessment
